verdict.rationale: Evidence shows generic building blocks (webhooks, workflows, third-party integrations) that could be used to push feedback into external task systems, but there is no explicit documentation of a feature that converts a feedback submission directly into a task, roadmap item, or project intention. missing for 10: explicit 'convert feedback to task/roadmap item' feature, named PM-tool integrations (e.g., Jira/Linear ticket creation), and any hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
